title: Act III missing sprites (kill-drone, rockets, scrap drones, bolts, shells, the Scrap Wastes card)
note: Every sprite that had no PNG in Act III, wired through the SpriteBank keys the code already asked for (code drawings stay as fallbacks; visual only, no gameplay change). The Kill-Drone is an AI source (one image, about $0.024) converted with the Empire pipeline and fixed by hand; every projectile is hand-built on the art grid by tools/act3_projectiles.py (no generation). Images are at 1x and x4 (nearest neighbour) on the Wastes slag colour; strips also as GIFs. Before / after crops are 1:1 frames of the same seeded autotest moments under xvfb (before = the new PNGs removed, so the code fallback draws; after = this branch). The projectile lineup is a scratch scene (not in the repo) that draws the real Projectile fallbacks and the EmpireShots tracer / shell fallback next to the art at one size.

runs.R3: --seed=3 --stage=wastes --policy=army --spells=death_mark,raise_dead --spawn=line_trooper@25x14,line_trooper@45x14,line_trooper@65x14 (Grave Gunners fire soul rounds: steel line, 10 raised, gunner dmg 137)
runs.scratch: the stage-card renderer and the projectile lineup are scratch Godot scenes (a StageVignette per stage / the Projectile node per kind), not in the repo

images.description: Kill-Drone (Purge Protocol): the Scout Drone's family made heavy: a broad warning-red armour plate, one big red lens with a hot core, two gun barrels under the body, two flat rotors. 70 x 32 (30 + 2 empty rows on top for the hover bob). AI source from the Scout Drone (art_source/empire/kill_drone.png), converted, lens and reds fixed by hand on the grid
Its hover strip: 8 frames, the whole drone bobs 2 px (walk_cycle.py "hover", like the Scout Drone)
Trojan Horse Swarm Rocket: chrome body, warning-red fins and band, amber warhead light. 24 x 12, facing +x, hand-built on the grid
Its exhaust: 3 flicker frames of 12 x 8, drawn behind the nozzle (replaces two code circles)
Scrap Swarm drone (also the Rust Prophet's): a bone skull-body with a violet eye, scrap jaw, two grey rotors; 2 rotor frames of 22 x 14
The Deathless Swarm kill drone: the same with violet rotors and a flare eye (replaces the old violet ring)
Scrap bolt: a bone shard wrapped in violet, 14 x 6, facing +x
Iron Revenant cannon shell (and the Deus Revenant's twin cannons): an iron ogive shell with a driving band and a soul-teal fire trail, 20 x 8
Grave Gunner rifle round: a soul-teal fire slug with a bright core, 12 x 5
Lock-On rail slug (Spotter, Kestrel): a warning-red needle with an amber sleeve and a white-hot core, 46 x 7 (EmpireRulesData rail "art")
Deus Ex Machina's Lock-On missile: chrome body, red fins and band, amber nose, a static exhaust, 26 x 10 (missile "art")
Mortar Walker shell: a chrome bomb with a warning-red band and an amber fuse light, 12 x 12 (mortar "art")
Deus Revenant missile (the undead's, a corpse boulder until now): iron body, bone nose, soul-teal exhaust, 26 x 10, turned along its arc by HordeHazards

The Scrap Wastes stage-select card (also the victory card): its own slag floor (tiles/wastes_slag, no longer the Crimson March's), a titan hull, a wreck plate, a slag mound and a tank trap, a signal pylon, an Aegis Bot and a Scout Drone, two undead, and Kestrel kneeling in her aim pose; drifting amber embers as before. Data only: no new PNG, the same kinds of items the Assembly and Citadel cards use. (the _x4 file is x3)

A Scrap Swarm drone (top left: bone body, violet eye, rotors) beside five Kill-Drones and three Swarm Rockets
The Reckoning swarm: Kill-Drones beside Scout Drones, one Swarm Rocket in flight
A Mortar Walker's lobbed shell: a chrome bomb with a red band and fuse light instead of an orange blob

Top row: the rail slug, Deus's missile, the mortar shell; right: the Deus Revenant missile (a skull boulder before). Below, each twice at two angles: the soul round, the scrap bolt, the iron shell. Code fallbacks left, art right, 1:1 on the Wastes floor (the Projectile node and the EmpireShots tracer logic draw both)
